findings.reason: This instance of Trojan_Trigger monitors the 128-bit state input for a highly specific sequence of four 128-bit values to activate a trigger signal.
This signal is the trigger output that activates the AM transmission module to leak the secret key when the rare state sequence is detected.
This register in Trojan_Trigger is asserted only when a specific sequence of four 128-bit values is sequentially matched on the state input.
This instance of AM_Transmission acts as the Trojan payload, leaking the secret key via an antenna output when triggered by Tj_Trig.
This state register tracks the first step of a rare 128-bit input pattern sequence matching trigger condition.
